lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: How many times did he say he stabbed her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What else did he do ta her? We already know, be honest.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: We've got enough of her to know some things that happened to her. So tell us the truth.

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What else did he do ta her?

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Did he tell you that? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: Tell us about that. And where he did it.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: I don't know where he did but

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: What did he say he did in his words? What did he tell you? You can, you can swear, you can use any of his language you want. Tell us exactly what he told you he did to her.

lines.speaker: BRENDAN
lines.text: That he ripped off her clothes and she refused and she tried to get away but he, he wa, he was too strong for her (pause) and he did it.

lines.speaker: FASSBENDER
lines.text: What did he say? Did he use those words? (Brendan nods “yes”)

lines.speaker: WIEGERT
lines.text: Are you sure (Brendan nods yes”) cuz its usu, not usually the words he uses? Are, are if you're sure, that's OK.
